t: Orchestra Of Lights | Gemmy Wiki | Fandom
s: October 29, 2024 - The Orchestra Of Lights are a series of lighted outdoor decorations made since 2018. They come in many varieties. They come in spotlights, pathway markers, light strings, snowflakes, wreathes, garland, and trees. All of them require a wifi network, the Orchestra Of Lights App on Google Play or the Apple App Store and either the 2018-2022 or 2023-present Orchestra Of Lights Wifi Hub to work properly.
